changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: The cash replay rounds its running balance to whole cents after every event (issue #563). Lot amounts are quantity × price and cross-currency transfers are amount × rate, so the balance used to keep fractions of a cent: a wallet whose cash was effectively zero read as holding cash, and a transfer of the full displayed amount could be refused as a fraction of a cent short. A purchase now takes its cash_used from the rounded balance, and anything below half a cent counts as zero. A purchase that costs less than half a cent more than the balance is paid entirely from cash, so it leaves no sub-cent new_money in the own-money series. wallet_cash, capital_timeline, the reconciliation list and the shortfall check all read the replay, so they follow.
